title: Thermal robustness of sensing quantum phases of matter via qubit probes
summary: We study the effect of temperature on the ability of a qubit probe to distinguish between different phases in strongly correlated systems. Now to this end, we investigate a spin-1/2 Heisenberg XXZ chain coupled to a qubit probe via a pure dephasing interaction. At zero temperature, as reported previously, the decoherence dynamics exhibit different behavior in the gapped and gapless phases of the chain, with characteristic strong oscillations in the gapped phase and monotonic decay in the gapless phase.
